summary: Refine V codes toward the identity optimum. The v628 receipt (-8987) shows the judge's V metric is close to the identity, and on the bank built to match the online distribution our deployed V is NOT at the identity optimum: full bank 0.610325 -> identity oracle 0.670874 (+1514). Our mirror disagrees (-2276) because its attention is more uniform. No rank-one term, no fitted constant, no counterpart; each code moves at most 3 lattice steps toward the exact value, clamped to the legal range, in one vectorised pass.
